errors.text_span: Върху графиката са представени две линии: първата е синя, със стълбовидна форма
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain two lines. The blue element is an area chart, not a line, and it does not have a "стълбовидна" (columnar/bar) shape.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е оранжева, със стълбовидна форма
errors.evidence: The orange element is a line chart, not a line with a "стълбовидна" (columnar/bar) shape.

The description incorrectly assigns the annual growth percentages to the wrong years. The chart shows 28% growth for 2018 (not 2017), 26% for 2019 (not 2018), and so on. There is no growth value shown for the base year 2017.

The description incorrectly states that the slope of the blue line does not change. The line forming the top of the blue area is visibly curved, indicating a changing slope (i.e., the growth rate is not constant).

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия също се увеличава последователно от 28% до 16%
errors.evidence: This statement is contradictory and factually incorrect. A change from 28% to 16% is a decrease, not an increase. Furthermore, the trend is not sequential (monotonic); the values fluctuate (e.g., 17% to 18%, 13% to 16%).

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия също се увеличава последователно от 28% до 16%, като нейната стойност расте постепенно, без промяна в наклона.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the orange line has no change in slope. The line is visibly not straight, as the growth rate changes each year.
